items.headline: SoftBank finally closes $10B loan against its OpenAI stake, after talks stalled over how to value a private company as collateral
items.note: OpenAI contributed zero investment gain/loss to SoftBank's Q1 print (masked by an Intel-stake windfall) and the OpenAI-collateralized loan only got done after lenders balked at pricing a private, unprofitable AI startup — a live data point on the fragility of collateral valuation in the OpenAI-Nvidia-SoftBank financing web.

items.headline: Fitch names an AI-driven market correction a top global credit risk in its Q3 2026 outlook
items.note: A major rating agency formally flagging AI-concentration risk to global credit alongside geopolitical risk is a notable escalation in tone, though it is a forward-looking warning rather than a realized event.

items.headline: CoreWeave forced to raise spread 100-125bps and accept maintenance covenants to get its $2.6B Anthropic-linked loan done
items.note: Leveraged-loan investors extracted a 9%+ yield, an OID discount, and a 1.35x debt-service-coverage covenant plus full amortization from CoreWeave — concrete evidence that credit markets are repricing neocloud/GPU-debt risk rather than just talking about it.
